A.name: Isolated Finaliser / synthetic session
A.description: Create a disposable synthetic ai_conversation_state row (or use a throwaway session_id). Invoke only Finaliser-equivalent SQL with three bound params (session, reference, token empty/present) via read-write psql under a later authorized phase — OR dry-run EXPLAIN with bound params. Prefer: execute the exact Finaliser UPDATE on a synthetic session that has no attempt, proving $1/$2/$3 bind and NULLIF behavior, then delete the synthetic session.
A.pgEffects: synthetic session only (insert+update+delete) if authorized; zero effect on rec008-8f2b14-new-01 and attempts

B.name: Full conversational path on new session
B.description: Activate workflow, run full create flow on a new session through mock → one POST → Finaliser. Proves end-to-end including $3.
B.doubleCreateRisk: one intentional mock POST; must not touch confirmed session

recommendationReason: Validates real PostgreSQL binding of $3 (including empty→NULL) with zero CLAIM/POST and no impact on the inconsistent confirmed session. Method B remains useful later as an integration test under separate authorization.
